item.title: Temperature records broken across the PNW

item.title: Oregon, along with much of the West, seeing 'worst snowpack in decades,' according to NOAA
item.description: Oregon's snowpack is looking in dire condition after January's dry spell has left much of the West with what NOAA is calling "the worst snowpack in decades."

item.title: Burnside Bridge closes due to mechanical issue
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. (KOIN) -- The Burnside Bridge closed due to a mechanical issue on Thursday afternoon, Multnomah County officials announced. The county says that the mechanical issue was found in the bridge's span locks after the completion of a lift. The bridge reopened at 7:30 p.m.

item.title: Oregon Governor Kotek, mayors demand ICE to halt operations until use of force incidents are investigated
item.description: Oregon Governor Tina Kotek and 31 Oregon mayors sent a letter to the Trump administration on Thursday, demanding an immediate pause on immigration enforcement in the state until all recent federal use-of-force incidents are investigated.
